name: RenderNet
definition: A differentiable rendering convolutional neural network that renders 2D images from 3D voxel grids by jointly learning visibility computation and pixel color calculation (shading).
summary: RenderNet is a differentiable rendering convolutional neural network that generates 2D images from 3D voxel grids by jointly learning visibility and shading, robustly handling low-resolution inputs unlike mesh-based alternatives.
